replies.text:
Using Opus to explain how not to torch Claude Code limits is peak 2026 energy.

The funny part is the meta-loop: a strong model generating educational motion about rationing a strong model. Ultracode and dynamic workflows only help if you treat context like a budget, not an infinite scratchpad.

Animations like this are useful because they make the failure mode visceral. Most people burn tokens on re-explaining the same repo instead of pinning a stable plan.
